newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse suspends Arctic on talks.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse suspends Arctic on talks.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said refrigerator maker Arctic would be suspended at its own request for 20 days starting Tuesday as its majority stockholder was negotiating the sale of its stake.
"Negotiations for the selloff of the majority stake held by the State Ownership Fund (FPS) might lead to speculative pressure on shares," an Arctic statement said.

The FPS, which has a controlling stake in most Romanian enterprises, holds 50.99 percent of Arctic. The company has a share capital of around 57.2 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each.
The Fund said it would start negotiations on the sale of its stake in Arctic with a foreign company.
Arctic, a first-tier share which joined the stock exchange this month, closed 250 lei down at 2,800 lei.
